metaDescription: Create wa.me links with a prefilled message from phone numbers. Cleans spaces, plus signs and (0). Free, private, in your browser.
intro: Create wa.me links with a prefilled message from phone numbers in international format. Cleans spaces, plus signs and dashes.
why:
A wa.me link opens a chat with a number and can fill in a message. It needs the number in full international form, digits only. Spaces, plus signs, brackets and a leading zero break it.

Paste numbers, one per line, and a message. The tool strips the extras, removes a (0) trunk digit, warns if no country code is visible or the length is unusual, and URL-encodes the message. The format is as commonly documented and was not opened here, so click one link to test.
howTo: Paste the numbers with country code.

faq.q: What format does the number need?
faq.a: Country code then number, digits only, no plus, zeros or brackets.

faq.q: What if a number starts with 0?
faq.a: It is a local number. Replace the leading 0 with the country code.
